package.name: moveit2_extended_waypoints
package.description:
Named arm targets: a YAML-backed store, a manager node that teaches from the robot's current state, and the Behaviors an Objective uses to reach them.
Distinct from the workspace's existing scripts/waypoint_manager.py, which is for the MOBILE BASE and speaks Nav2's FollowWaypoints. Sharing a format between the two would only make it easier to replay a base waypoint on the arm.
